item.description:
## Scheduled conversations
Schedule conversations to run automatically and review their upcoming run times. Completed runs stay organized in the conversation with a bounded history, so you can follow recent results without an ever-growing transcript.
## Easier scheduling controls
Adjust schedules and branch settings from clearer controls, and move between scheduled runs directly in Chat.

## Review workflow
Start Auto Fix even when a review has no findings, manage checkouts and local branches from the Review panel, and use collapsible sections to keep the panel focused. Auto Fix now shows its next actions in the conversation and reaches the commit step faster.
## Engine status
See Grok and Antigravity availability in the app.

## Grok support
Use Grok for conversations and code review, including Grok Build through ACP.
## Project and worktree settings
Choose local or remote repository sources, configure worktree folders and commands per project, and start a subthread from a conversation's context menu.
## Review workflow improvements
Manage local branches from the Review panel, see review actions and Auto Fix progress in the conversation, and apply selected fixes in the order shown. Ask an agent for help when worktree cleanup fails.
